title: The Traveler from the Far Side

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.before: A traveler from a village on the far side of the island arrives
ledger.after: (Name1), a traveler from a village on the far side of the island, arrives
ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A traveler from the far side of the island arrives for the first time, unsure about local customs at mealtime.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a traveler from a village on the far side of the island, arrives for the first time and seems unsure about local customs at mealtime.

choices.label: Invite Them to Eat Their Own Way.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The traveler learns quickly and shares their own customs too.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The traveler finds some customs strange but follows them politely.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Some villagers are puzzled, but no one objects.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: They discover shared interests in fishing.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The conversation is slow, but friendly.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The traveler tells stories that fascinate the children.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The traveler prefers not to talk about home, and the villager changes the subject.

b1__fx.name: Outcome B1
b1__fx.text: The traveler relaxes, and the villagers learn something new.
